exposure: Right heart defects or biventricular cyanotic heart defects vs. other types of CHD
outcome: Urgent cesarean delivery (CD) due to acute intrapartum non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS)
cohort: 199 singletons prenatally diagnosed with a congenital heart defect (CHD) and for whom vaginal delivery was attempted
finding: Fetal heart failure (CVP score ≤7), low birth weight (<2500 g), and primipara status were independent predictors of urgent CD due to acute intrapartum NRFS in CHD infants.
mod_finding: The study investigated the predictors of urgent cesarean delivery due to acute intrapartum non-reassuring fetal status in infants with congenital heart defects.
